themes_detail.label: Graffiti explosion in East Harlem
themes_detail.summary: Graffiti complaints spiked dramatically to 6 reports THIS WEEK compared to a baseline of 0.4 per week over the prior 8 weeks—a 1500% increase (z-score: 11.62)—suggesting a coordinated tagging campaign or enforcement gap that warrants urgent investigation, especially given the community board's year-over-year budget request for increased graffiti removal.
evidence: 6 graffiti complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (1500% spike)
Z-score of 11.62 indicates statistically severe anomaly
Community board has made 'Increase Graffiti Removal/Cleaning' a repeated capital budget request, signaling chronic underinvestment
reporting_angles: Interview residents and business owners on 125th Street corridor and side streets to document visible tagging patterns and timeline

Investigate whether DSNY graffiti removal crews have been deployed to the district; cross-check with DOE permit filings (549 total, including 62 new buildings) for construction-related access disruptions

themes_detail.label: Street noise surge amid active construction
themes_detail.summary: Street and sidewalk noise complaints surged to 92 reports THIS WEEK versus a 8-week baseline of 19.2 per week—a 378% spike (z-score: 9.03)—coinciding with 549 DOB permit filings (including 62 new buildings and 455 alterations) and a separate noise complaint spike of 43 reports (199% above baseline), suggesting construction activity is overwhelming the district.
evidence: Street/sidewalk noise: 92 complaints THIS WEEK vs. 19.2 weekly average (378% spike, z-score: 9.03)
General noise: 43 complaints THIS WEEK vs. 14.4 weekly average (199% spike, z-score: 5.08)
549 DOB permits filed in last 90 days (455 alterations + 62 new buildings), including active ULURP application at 58-62 East 125th Street
reporting_angles: Map the 92 street noise complaints against DOB permit locations to identify which construction projects are driving complaints
Interview residents on East 125th Street (major rezoning applications pending) and adjacent blocks about construction hours, noise barriers, and city enforcement

themes_detail.label: Encampment complaints at unprecedented levels
themes_detail.summary: Encampment-related 311 complaints jumped to 15 reports THIS WEEK, a 500% increase over the 8-week baseline of 2.5 per week (z-score: 6.68)—the first statistically severe spike in this category—suggesting either a rapid growth in unsheltered populations or increased resident reporting of a newly visible issue.
evidence: 15 encampment complaints THIS WEEK vs. 2.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (500% spike, z-score: 6.68)
Community board's year-over-year budget request for 'Other programs to address public health issues' reflects ongoing concern
High heat/hot water complaint volume (3,852 over 90 days) and unsanitary conditions (848 complaints) suggest housing stress that may correlate with homelessness
reporting_angles: Ground-truth reporting: Walk East 125th Street, Park Avenue, and Lexington Avenue corridors to document encampment locations, population size, and resident interactions
Interview DHS, NYPD Outreach, and community stakeholders about any recent policy changes, shelter capacity limits, or outreach initiatives in CD111

themes_detail.label: Construction/plumbing crisis escalating
themes_detail.summary: General construction and plumbing complaints hit 19 reports THIS WEEK, a 210% increase over the 8-week baseline of 6.1 per week (z-score: 5.21), while plumbing complaints remain consistently high (684 over 90 days), suggesting widespread building infrastructure failures coinciding with the 549 active DOB permits.
evidence: General construction/plumbing complaints: 19 THIS WEEK vs. 6.1 weekly average (210% spike, z-score: 5.21)
Plumbing complaints remain elevated at 684 total complaints over 90 days (4th-highest category)
DEP capital budget request appears in community board's year-over-year requests, indicating systemic water/plumbing infrastructure gaps
reporting_angles: Investigate whether permitted construction projects are damaging water mains or apartment plumbing; request DOB inspection records for citations
Profile a building with multiple plumbing complaints to illustrate infrastructure aging and landlord compliance gaps

themes_detail.label: Illegal tree damage amid street concerns
themes_detail.summary: Illegal tree damage complaints spiked 2300% to 3 reports two weeks ago versus a baseline of 0.1 per week (z-score: 8.69)—a rare environmental signal—while street condition complaints (416 over 90 days) and street sweeping concerns remain elevated, suggesting neglect or vandalism of public green space.
evidence: Illegal tree damage: 3 complaints 2 WEEKS AGO vs. 0.1 weekly baseline (2300% spike, z-score: 8.69)
Street condition complaints: 416 total over 90 days (9th-highest category)
Community board requests 'park, building, or access improvements' from DOT year-over-year, indicating sustained neglect
reporting_angles: Identify the 3 specific tree damage locations and determine if they were vandalism, construction-related, or due to deferred maintenance
Assess whether Parks Department has adequate staffing for inspections and enforcement in CD111
